note: Adapter convention, not a contract: each case observation source name is read from these product tables (organization-scoped, recordedAt <= knownAt). Rows carry CSN element names; 'id' is the row ID. A multi-table source adds '_table'. Derived fields are listed per table and computed in ScenarioJdbcObservation. A requested source missing here makes the observation NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Recovery issues are independent SQL projections of trigger-owned, application-clock history; incomplete legacy history is unsupported.
approximateNote: Sources whose table choice is still a guess (s5b review); an assertion failure on them is classified ADAPTER until the mapping is confirmed. confirmed lists the s5b review of the former s5a guesses. identity_matches: source-identity reconciliations and claim verifications (identityMatched) together. domain_records: per-table count/digest of organization business rows, not a domain state. capabilities: the definitions' CapabilityContracts table (the product keeps capability manifests inside the package content). regressionRuns: the product does not execute regression fixtures; one DefinitionValidations row per validation (its regressionJson lists the declared fixtureRefs with status NOT_RUN), not one row per fixture run.

confirmed.commandResults: CommandRecords carries state and resultJson of each command
confirmed.evidence: DocumentVersions are the immutable evidence originals (supersedesId chain)
confirmed.evidence_revisions: DocumentVersions revisions/supersedesId are the evidence revisions
confirmed.intake: InboxRecords is the source intake ledger (state, intakeOwnerId, nextCheckAt)
confirmed.intakes: InboxRecords is the source intake ledger
confirmed.newAllocations: SegmentAllocations; assertions select the new rows by commandIdempotencyKey/where
confirmed.observationCoverage: STATE_OBSERVATION Events joined to their actual Claims, VERIFIED Verifications, CanonicalOccurrences and available DocumentVersions. Closed coverage endpoints come from the matching persisted payload; this is not responsibility CompletionCoverages.
confirmed.receiptContributions: ReceiptCredits holds contributedQuantity/excessQuantity per receipt and PO line
confirmed.supplierCommitments: SupplierReplies preserves ACCEPT/REJECT/CHANGE and proposedQuantity. SQL scopes replies through the exact same-organization immutable Orders proposalId/revision/hash and ProposalRevisions item/work, with knownAt fences. LOT requires explicit scopeJson.lotId on the revision-pinned immutable GoalReferences; current Work/proposal state is never substituted. Missing, ambiguous, mismatched or time-ineligible links are unsupported, including when a scoped result would otherwise be empty.
confirmed.adjustmentProposals: settlement Adjustments carry mode (PROPOSE/CONFIRM), status and proposalId
confirmed.orders: sales Orders and purchase Orders (rows carry _table)
confirmed.businessOutbox: runtime Outbox is the only business outbox
confirmed.constraints: Restrictions and DispositionBases are the eligibility constraints (rows carry _table)
confirmed.notices: recall Actions rows; kind distinguishes notices
confirmed.recoveries: recall Actions rows; kind distinguishes recoveries
confirmed.conditions: Raw typed restriction/disposition/quality/regulatory/label rows, retaining table identity and stored states. No unified ALLOWED or eligibility conclusion is inferred.
confirmed.conditionResults: Scoped AssessmentReferences.conditionsJson entries, preserving original conditionId/evaluatorVersion/inputs; result/conflict from truth and evidenceIds from evidenceRefs. No identity aliases or default quantities.
confirmed.supervisionIssues: RecoveryObservationHistory stores each original recovery row, transaction ExecutionClock, same-instant sequence and immutable source scope. The independent SQL observer selects the latest known row, suppresses only recorded tombstones/non-held states, and refuses missing history or scope proof.

derived.mulino_inventory_QuantityMovements: segmentId=targetId, else sourceId (the segment the movement lands on)
derived.mulino_work_read_ObligationReferences: current=valid, responsibleWorkId=workId, obligationId=rootId, sourceKind/sourceId from responsibility Roots
derived.any row with commandId: commandIdempotencyKey, capabilityId, stableRequestOwnerId from the CommandRecords row; a row whose commandId is null or names no CommandRecords row (fixture-installed) carries commandIdempotencyKey NO_COMMAND_RECORD
derived.any row without a commandId column: commandIdempotencyKey, capabilityId, stableRequestOwnerId of the earliest COMMITTED CommandRecords row whose resultJson (effects, *Id fields) names the row id (approximate creating command); otherwise commandIdempotencyKey NO_COMMAND_RECORD
derived.mulino_work_read_GoalReferences: quantity=targetQuantity (target only); placeId/periodStart/periodEnd from immutable slotsJson; intervalStart/intervalEnd/startInclusive/endInclusive from period fields; eventKinds is the stored single eventKind list; distinctContributionScope=contributionScope, evaluationTime=evaluationAt, eligibilityAction=action, includeReservations=includeReserved. No nested expression search, default endpoints or policy versions
derived.mulino_work_read_AssessmentReferences: result=outcome, goalVersionId=goalId; definitionVersion/policyVersion from exact stored version IDs; conditionResults from conditionsJson; inputSnapshotIds from exact assessment/work/goal/hash binding
derived.mulino_evaluation_InputSnapshots: inputSnapshot from contentJson, conditionResults from its immutable conditions, goalVersionId=goalId; no missing input or quantity is invented
derived.mulino_trade_purchase_SupplierReplies: purchaseId=orderId, quantity=proposedQuantity, preserving original columns/reply/unit. itemId/workId/proposalRevisionId/proposalHash from the exact immutable order/revision/hash chain; goalVersionId and optional explicit lotId from that revision-pinned GoalReferences.scopeJson. No transmission, acceptance or physical arrival state is inferred. Every validation and scoped query uses bound parameters in the same read-only REPEATABLE_READ snapshot.
derived.mulino_trade_purchase_Approvals: conditions from conditionsJson; consumptionPolicy is the actual immutable stored value (historical NULL stays unknown), never an observer default
derived.mulino_evidence_Events: Only a verified, matching persisted STATE_OBSERVATION chain can supply canonical quantity/unit; payload alone is not verified evidence

virtual.@transactions: one row per PostgreSQL xmin that last wrote an organization CommandRecords row
virtual.@conditionResults: Scoped AssessmentReferences.conditionsJson entries, preserving original conditionId/evaluatorVersion/inputs; result/conflict from truth and evidenceIds from evidenceRefs. No identity aliases or default quantities.
virtual.@supervisionIssues: Latest RecoveryObservationHistory row per original source at recordedAt <= knownAt, with ID ordering for same-instant changes. Only stored HELD_MANUAL schedules and HELD_POLICY/HELD_LINK/HELD_MANUAL intakes are issues. Original source fields and immutable organization/item/work/LOT binding are retained; DELETE is a tombstone. Current sources must match their last history snapshot; missing legacy history or unproven scope is refused. All SQL uses the same read-only REPEATABLE_READ transaction and bound parameters.
virtual.@domainRecords: Refused: no complete per-table item/work/lot/time binding is available.
virtual.@observationCoverage: STATE_OBSERVATION Events joined to their actual Claims, VERIFIED Verifications, CanonicalOccurrences and available DocumentVersions. Closed coverage endpoints come from the matching persisted payload; this is not responsibility CompletionCoverages.
virtual.@assessmentInputs: One row per stored input snapshot condition (or snapshot if no conditions), with snapshotId equal to actual InputSnapshots.ID, original contentJson/hash/ID and conditionId/inputs/evidenceIds. Requires unique same-organization assessment/snapshot, matching Work/Goal/asOf/knownAt/conditions, SHA-256 of exact contentJson bytes, and matching embedded Goal/slots when present. All joins use the caller read-only snapshot/knownAt. Missing or ambiguous bindings are unsupported; no source IDs, quantities or shared snapshot identity are invented.

unmapped.locks: the product keeps no durable record of fence/lock acquisitions (advisory locks are transaction-scoped); T04/T16/V3 read acquisitionOrdinal, lockedRevision, scopeFenceId of each acquisition
unmapped.lockWaits: pg_locks shows a waiting backend, but the product exposes neither the fence-key-to-scopeId mapping nor the barrier transactionId of a PostgreSQL backend; V2/V3/V8 read scopeId and transactionId
unmapped.tombstones: the product implements no retention deletion (plan §7.4 retention policy, tombstone/redaction and blob deletion reconciliation are not built); T24 reads document tombstones
unmapped.deletion_log: no deletion reconciliation log exists for the same reason (plan §7.4 not implemented); T24 reads documentId, originalHash, blobState, policyVersion, reviewerId
unmapped.migrationMappings: the migration mapping is kept in the WORK_MIGRATION review payload (DefinitionReviews.payloadJson), not as one row per field
unmapped.migrationRegressions: the product does not execute regression fixtures (plan §8 regression results deferred)
unmapped.scopedDomainRecords: The legacy all-table digest cannot prove every requested scope/time boundary and is refused.
